column4: dialect-gated: single CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL gate, one skip. Regression test for cleat#2210/cleat#2758: forces a real SQL Server deadlock against the real ConsumeSignal call and checks signal_consumed_seq lands at exactly 1 after its withRollbackGuaranteedRetry wrapper retries. Measured: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run TestMSSQLStore_ConsumeSignalDeadlockRetryDoesNotDoubleIncrement -count=1 -json | grep -c '"Action":"skip"' reports 1.
